meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Pashan | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: JEE coaching for Pashan students at our New Sangvi head office, with faculty from Kota. Students from St Joseph High School, Pashan, study with us.

intro: From Pashan, our nearest centre is the head office in New Sangvi, about {{commute:pashan#km}} km away through Aundh.

sections.heading: Getting to New Sangvi from Pashan

body.text: Take Dr Homi Bhabha Marg and University Road to Aundh, cross the river to Sangvi Phata, then follow the Pimple Gurav-Navi Sangvi Road to Krishna Nagar Road Number 2.
Pashan has IISER Pune, the National Chemical Laboratory and the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology close by. Few areas give a student interested in science such a view of where it can lead.
Students from St Joseph High School in Pashan study with us.
Pashan students join after Class 10 for two years, or in Class 12 for one, with at most {{fact:batch.size}} in a batch.

questions.q: Which centre is closer to Pashan?
questions.a: The [head office in New Sangvi](page:centre-sangvi-head-office). Our Wakad branch is a longer drive.

questions.q: Do students from Pashan study with you?

a.text: Yes, including students from St Joseph High School.

questions.q: What if traffic makes my child miss a class?

a.text: Lectures are also online, so the class can be watched later.
